title: DNA Binding Properties of Novel Pyrrolyl Quinones Derivatives: Insights from Spectroscopic, Electrophoretic and Computational Studies.
authors: Barbosa-Munoz, Sandra G; Tapia-Juarez, Melissa; Ramirez-Guzman, Diana S; Gallardo-Alfonzo, Salvador; Orozco-Lopez, Fabian; Solorio-Alvarado, Cesar R; Cortes-Garcia, Carlos J; Chacon-Garcia, Luis
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型吡咯醌衍生物与DNA的结合性质，采用光谱、电泳及分子对接方法，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但非TF-DNA，且方法以实验为主、计算为辅，对本课题有部分借鉴价值。
abstract: In this work, we report the synthesis and Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)-binding properties of a new series of pyrrolyl quinone derivatives. These compounds were prepared from 2,5-dimethyl-1,4-benzoquinone through Michael-type addition/oxidation and electrophilic aromatic substitution reactions using pyrrole and bis-pyrrole nucleophiles. Additional structural diversification was achieved by reacting the pyrrolyl quinone intermediate either with 1-aminoanthracene or with acetone, affording new pyrrolyl quinone derivatives through distinct synthetic pathways. Owing to the electron-deficient pi-conjugated nature of the pyrrolyl quinone scaffold, their ability to interact with DNA was investigated by ultraviolet-visible (UV-vis) spectroscopy, gel electrophoresis, viscosity studies and molecular docking analyses. The combined results demonstrate that these new pyrrolyl quinone derivatives interact with DNA, highlighting the potential of this scaffold as a promising platform for molecular recognition and future drug-design applications.
abstract_zh: 在本项工作中，我们报道了一系列新型吡咯基醌衍生物的合成及其脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）结合特性。这些化合物通过2,5-二甲基-1,4-苯醌与吡咯及双吡咯亲核试剂，经由迈克尔加成/氧化及亲电芳香取代反应制备。通过将吡咯基醌中间体与1-氨基蒽或丙酮反应，经由不同合成路径，实现了进一步的结构多样化，获得了新型吡咯基醌衍生物。鉴于吡咯基醌骨架具有缺电子的π共轭特性，我们通过紫外-可见（UV-vis）光谱、凝胶电泳、粘度研究及分子对接分析，探究了其与DNA相互作用的能力。综合结果表明，这些新型吡咯基醌衍生物能与DNA结合，凸显了该骨架作为分子识别及未来药物设计应用中一个有前景平台的潜力。
